responsibility: Implements a HIR-level readonly-assignment checker for the Rust frontend before GCC tree lowering. It walks crate items with a DefaultHIRVisitor, tracks when traversal is examining the left-hand side of an assignment via a stacked mutable-context, resolves assigned paths back to HIR definitions through immutable name resolution and Analysis::Mappings, and emits diagnostics for writes to immutable local bindings, immutable statics, constants, non-mutable reference or pointer dereferences, and obviously non-assignable locations. It also records which pattern-bound locals have already received an initializing assignment from let bindings so later reassignments to non-mut variables can be distinguished from their initial definition.
same_name_distinction: Defines the executable implementation of the second readonly-check pass: it provides ReadonlyChecker method bodies, performs the actual HIR traversal and diagnostics, and contains the assignment-state tracking logic used during checking, whereas the same-stem header only declares that visitor interface and its helper APIs.
